description: Implementation of the E1AP CU-UP protocol handling, including message processing, UE context management, and procedures for setup, release, modification, and reset within a 3GPP network component.

classes.name: e1ap_rx_pdu_adapter
classes.description: Adapter class converting E1AP Rx PDUs from CU-CP into messages for handling.

classes.name: e1ap_cu_up_impl
classes.description: Main class implementing E1AP CU-UP protocol logic, message handling, and UE context management.

classes.name: e1ap_message_notifier_with_logging
classes.description: Wrapper class adding logging capabilities to message notification forwarding.

methods.name: connect_to_cu_cp
methods.description: Establishes connection to CU-CP and sets up message notifier.

methods.name: handle_message
methods.description: Main message dispatcher based on PDU type.

methods.name: handle_initiating_message
methods.description: Processes initiating messages based on type.

methods.name: handle_bearer_context_setup_request
methods.description: Handles bearer context setup requests, including validation and UE context creation.

methods.name: handle_successful_outcome
methods.description: Processes successful outcome messages, resumes suspended procedures.

methods.name: handle_unsuccessful_outcome
methods.description: Processes unsuccessful outcome messages, resumes procedures with errors.

methods.name: on_new_message
methods.description: Logs and forwards new messages in notifier wrapper.
